Appearance

refetchAn HTTP client on native fetch

Result objects instead of exceptions, typed errors, retry, schema validation and streaming. Zero runtime dependencies.

Read the guide
Compare with ky, ofetch and others

Failures are values

Every call resolves to a response with ok, problem and a discriminated error. Opt into throwing with throwOnError or unwrap() where a rejection suits better.

Validated, typed data

Pass a Zod, Valibot or ArkType schema and data is checked at the boundary and typed from the schema.

Retry and timeouts that behave

Per-attempt and total timeouts, Retry-After support, back-off with jitter, and cancels that are never retried.

Streaming for LLM workloads

POST and read Server-Sent Events or NDJSON as an async iterable from the /stream sub-path.

Safe defaults

Bearer tokens stay on your API's origin, responses can be size-capped, and credentials are kept out of logs and error reports.

Runs everywhere fetch does

Node, Bun, Deno, browsers and workers. ESM and CJS, tree-shakeable sub-paths.
